messages.content: Selamat petang. Saya Encik Lim, platform engineer Tonton Media. Pagi tadi data science team minta deploy pipeline baru `recommender-v3` ke production untuk Mobile Legends recommendation engine. Pipeline ID `pipe-tonton-rec-001`. Sebelum tu boleh tolong list dulu pipelines yang ada pada gateway `gw-tonton-prod`, status deployed sahaja, supaya saya tahu apa yang sedia ada?
Selamat petang Encik Lim. Saya akan paparkan senarai pipeline yang telah deployed pada gateway tersebut. Mohon tunggu sebentar.

messages.name: list_gateway_pipelines
messages.content: {"items": [{"pipeline_id": "pipe-tonton-rec-001", "name": "Tonton Recommender", "owner_team": "ml-platform", "current_version_id": "pv-tonton-rec-001-v2", "current_version_label": "v2.4.1", "status": "deployed", "environment": "prod"}, {"pipeline_id": "pipe-tonton-search-002", "name": "Tonton Search Ranker", "current_version_id": "pv-tonton-search-002-v1", "current_version_label": "v1.7.2", "status": "deployed", "environment": "prod"}, {"pipeline_id": "pipe-tonton-fraud-003", "name": "Tonton Fraud Detector", "current_version_id": "pv-tonton-fraud-003-v3", "current_version_label": "v3.0.0", "status": "deployed", "environment": "prod"}], "total": 3, "page": 1, "page_size": 50}

Berikut pipeline aktif di `gw-tonton-prod`, Encik:

| Pipeline | Versi semasa | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `pipe-tonton-rec-001` (Tonton Recommender) | v2.4.1 (`pv-tonton-rec-001-v2`) | deployed |
| `pipe-tonton-search-002` | v1.7.2 | deployed |
| `pipe-tonton-fraud-003` | v3.0.0 | deployed |

Versi semasa Tonton Recommender adalah **v2.4.1**. Encik nak deploy v3 — saya cadangkan kita define version baru dulu (DAG + IO contract), kemudian run readiness checks sebelum canary. Boleh Encik kongsi DAG nodes yang Encik nak guna, atau Encik nak saya base on `pv-tonton-rec-001-v2` dengan changelog kasi tahu apa yang berubah?

Base on v2 punya, label `v3.0.0-rc1`. Tambah satu node `feature_store_v3` (transform) sebelum `inference`. Nodes: `kafka_ingest` (ingest) -> `feature_store_v3` (transform, image `tonton/feat-v3:latest`, 2 CPU, 4Gi memory) -> `inference` (model_inference, image `tonton/rec:v3`, 4 CPU, 8Gi, 1 GPU T4) -> `sink_kafka` (sink). Changelog: 'Add v3 feature store with realtime device context.'
Baik Encik, saya akan define version baru tersebut dengan DAG yang Encik sebutkan.

function.name: define_pipeline_version
function.arguments: {"pipeline_id": "pipe-tonton-rec-001", "base_version_id": "pv-tonton-rec-001-v2", "version_label": "v3.0.0-rc1", "changelog": "Add v3 feature store with realtime device context.", "graph": {"nodes": [{"node_id": "kafka_ingest", "type": "ingest", "config": {"resources": {"cpu": "1", "memory": "2Gi"}}}, {"node_id": "feature_store_v3", "type": "transform", "config": {"image": "tonton/feat-v3:latest", "resources": {"cpu": "2", "memory": "4Gi"}, "retries": {"max_attempts": 3, "backoff_seconds": 2, "strategy": "exponential"}}}, {"node_id": "inference", "type": "model_inference", "config": {"image": "tonton/rec:v3", "resources": {"cpu": "4", "memory": "8Gi", "gpu": {"count": 1, "type": "T4"}}, "retries": {"max_attempts": 2, "backoff_seconds": 1, "strategy": "fixed"}}}, {"node_id": "sink_kafka", "type": "sink", "config": {"resources": {"cpu": "1", "memory": "2Gi"}}}], "edges": [{"from": "kafka_ingest", "to": "feature_store_v3"}, {"from": "feature_store_v3", "to": "inference"}, {"from": "inference", "to": "sink_kafka"}]}, "io_contract": {"validation": {"strict": true, "reject_on_unknown_fields": false}}, "metadata_overrides": {"tags": ["recommender", "v3", "realtime-device-context"]}}

messages.content: {"pipeline_version_id": "pv-tonton-rec-001-v3rc1", "pipeline_id": "pipe-tonton-rec-001", "version_label": "v3.0.0-rc1", "validation": {"is_valid": true, "warnings": ["GPU node 'inference' will require T4 quota check at deploy time"]}, "created_at": "2026-05-21T14:30:00+08:00"}

Version `pv-tonton-rec-001-v3rc1` berjaya dicipta, Encik:

- DAG validation: **valid**
- Warning: GPU T4 quota akan disemak masa deploy.

Next, saya cadangkan dua tindakan **selari** sebelum deploy ke prod: (1) jalankan readiness checks (schema/backward compat, security, performance baseline, dependency health) untuk version baru ni, dan (2) deploy ke staging dulu untuk smoke test. Setuju?
Yes, please jalankan kedua-duanya parallel. Untuk staging deploy guna strategy rolling, autoscale min 2 max 5, target latency 200ms.
Baik Encik, saya akan jalankan readiness checks dan staging deployment secara serentak.

messages.name: deploy_pipeline_version
messages.content: {"deployment_id": "dep-stg-tonton-rec-v3rc1-001", "pipeline_id": "pipe-tonton-rec-001", "pipeline_version_id": "pv-tonton-rec-001-v3rc1", "environment": "staging", "deployment_strategy": "rolling", "status": "in_progress", "created_at": "2026-05-21T14:31:14+08:00", "rollout_plan": {"phases": [{"phase": "warm_up", "replicas": 2}, {"phase": "steady", "replicas_target": 2, "max_replicas": 5}]}}

Hasil dua-dua tindakan, Encik:

**Readiness report `rdy-2026-05-21-001` — pass_with_warnings:**
- schema_compatibility: pass
- backward_compatibility: pass (new optional `device_context` field)
- security_policies: pass
- performance_baseline: **warn** — P95 latency 218ms vs baseline 195ms (+11.8%, masih dalam tolerance)
- dependency_health: pass
- Sample error rate: 0.5%

**Staging deployment `dep-stg-tonton-rec-v3rc1-001`:**
- Status: in_progress, rolling, replicas 2->5 (latency target 200ms)

Latency warning tu perlu diawasi. Sambil staging warm up, adakah Encik nak saya tarik status deployment dan paparkan butiran pipeline + route untuk konteks penuh sebelum kita configure prod canary?
Yes, get deployment status sekali get pipeline & route details untuk pipeline ni — saya nak tengok existing route configuration.
Baik Encik, saya akan ambil status deployment staging dan butiran pipeline + route serentak.

messages.name: get_pipeline_and_route_details
messages.content: {"pipeline_id": "pipe-tonton-rec-001", "name": "Tonton Recommender", "owner": {"team": "ml-platform", "contact_email": "ml-platform@tonton.com.my"}, "tags": ["recommender", "realtime"], "latest_deployment": {"deployment_id": "dep-prod-tonton-rec-v2-014", "version_label": "v2.4.1", "environment": "prod"}, "routes": [{"route_id": "route-rec-prod-001", "environment": "prod", "path": "/v1/recommendations", "protocol": "https", "methods": ["POST"], "auth": "api_key", "current_traffic": {"strategy": "single", "weights": [{"pipeline_version_id": "pv-tonton-rec-001-v2", "weight": 1.0}]}}]}

Encik, kedua-dua hasil:

**Staging deployment status:**
- Phase: **ready** | health checks 12 pass / 0 fail
- Resource: 31% CPU, 44% memory, 26% GPU — masih lapang

**Pipeline & route prod sedia ada:**
- Route `route-rec-prod-001` -> `/v1/recommendations` (POST, HTTPS, API key)
- 100% trafik kini ke v2 (`pv-tonton-rec-001-v2`)

Staging dah ready. Untuk pengeluaran prod, saya cadangkan **canary 10% selama 30 minit, kemudian 50% selama 30 minit, akhirnya 100%**, dengan auto-promote pada metric latency. Adakah Encik approve untuk teruskan dengan strategi canary tu?
Approve. Deploy canary ke prod sekarang. Selepas tu update route traffic split — gradual shift 10% step, every 15 minutes, target version yang baru.
Baik Encik, saya akan deploy canary ke prod dan kemudian configure traffic split gradual.

messages.content: {"deployment_id": "dep-prod-tonton-rec-v3rc1-001", "pipeline_id": "pipe-tonton-rec-001", "pipeline_version_id": "pv-tonton-rec-001-v3rc1", "environment": "prod", "deployment_strategy": "canary", "status": "in_progress", "current_phase": "canary_step_1", "created_at": "2026-05-21T14:34:00+08:00"}

Canary deployment ke prod berjaya dimulakan, Encik:

- **Deployment ID:** `dep-prod-tonton-rec-v3rc1-001`
- **Phase:** canary_step_1 (10% traffic, auto-promote)

Sekarang saya akan setup traffic split gradual pada route prod.

function.name: update_route_traffic_split
function.arguments: {"route_id": "route-rec-prod-001", "environment": "prod", "strategy": "weighted", "weights": [{"pipeline_version_id": "pv-tonton-rec-001-v2", "weight": 0.9}, {"pipeline_version_id": "pv-tonton-rec-001-v3rc1", "weight": 0.1}], "gradual_shift": {"enabled": true, "step_percentage": 10, "step_interval_minutes": 15, "target_pipeline_version_id": "pv-tonton-rec-001-v3rc1"}, "reason": "Canary rollout v3.0.0-rc1 for realtime device context feature"}

messages.name: update_route_traffic_split
messages.content: {"route_id": "route-rec-prod-001", "environment": "prod", "new_strategy": "weighted", "current_weights": [{"pipeline_version_id": "pv-tonton-rec-001-v2", "weight": 0.9}, {"pipeline_version_id": "pv-tonton-rec-001-v3rc1", "weight": 0.1}], "gradual_shift_scheduled": {"enabled": true, "step_percentage": 10, "step_interval_minutes": 15, "next_step_at": "2026-05-21T14:49:00+08:00", "target_pipeline_version_id": "pv-tonton-rec-001-v3rc1"}, "applied_at": "2026-05-21T14:34:30+08:00"}

Traffic split telah diapply, Encik:

- Sekarang: v2 = 90%, v3rc1 = 10%
- Gradual shift: +10% setiap 15 minit ke v3rc1
- Next step: 2:49 PM (14:49)

Adakah Encik mahu subscribe webhook untuk dapat notifikasi setiap kali peratusan berubah, dan sekali search senarai semua deployment prod aktif untuk lain-lain pipeline supaya kita ada gambaran penuh?

Yes. Subscribe webhook `https://hooks.tonton.com.my/api-pipeline` untuk event deployment status_changed dan failed, name `tonton-rec-rollout-events`. Dan run advanced search untuk semua deployments dalam prod yang `in_progress`.
Baik Encik, saya jalankan kedua-dua serentak.

messages.content: {"subscription_id": "evtsub-tonton-rec-001", "subscription_name": "tonton-rec-rollout-events", "enabled": true, "channels_validated": [{"channel": "webhook", "target": "https://hooks.tonton.com.my/api-pipeline", "validation_status": "signed_handshake_ok"}], "created_at": "2026-05-21T14:35:10+08:00"}

messages.name: api_pipeline_search_advanced
messages.content: {"total_count": 1, "hits": [{"deployment_id": "dep-prod-tonton-rec-v3rc1-001", "pipeline_id": "pipe-tonton-rec-001", "pipeline_version_id": "pv-tonton-rec-001-v3rc1", "environment": "prod", "status": "in_progress", "current_phase": "canary_step_1"}], "pagination": {"page": 1, "page_size": 20, "total_count": 1}}

Selesai, Encik:

- **Webhook `evtsub-tonton-rec-001`** signed-handshake OK, retry exponential max 5.
- **Advanced search:** hanya **satu** deployment in_progress di prod sekarang — `dep-prod-tonton-rec-v3rc1-001` (yang kita baru launch). Tiada deploy lain mengganggu.

Semua bersih untuk teruskan canary. Adakah ada apa-apa lagi yang Encik perlu pantau?

Satu lagi — saya nampak ada beberapa invocation v2 tadi gagal dengan timeout sekitar 1 PM. Boleh retry failed invocations untuk pipeline ni, time range 12:30 PM sampai 1:30 PM, error kind timeout sahaja, dry_run dulu supaya saya tahu berapa banyak.
Baik Encik, saya jalankan dry-run retry untuk failed invocations dalam window tersebut.

messages.name: retry_failed_pipeline_invocations
messages.content: {"retry_job_id": "rtjob-dryrun-001", "dry_run": true, "selected_invocations": 84, "breakdown_by_error_kind": {"timeout": 84}, "estimated_cost_units": 168, "estimated_duration_seconds": 12, "would_apply": false}

Dry-run report, Encik:

- **Selected invocations:** 84 (semua timeout)
- **Estimated duration:** 12 saat (dengan concurrency 50)
- **Estimated cost units:** 168

Memandangkan jumlah relatif kecil, retry sebenar selamat untuk diteruskan. Adakah Encik mahu saya komit retry sebenarnya (`dry_run: false`) sekarang, atau tinggalkan sehingga selepas canary v3 selesai supaya tidak mencampur dengan keluk trafik baru?

Tinggalkan dulu, saya retry nanti selepas v3 100%. Sebelum tutup — boleh attach gateway policy untuk rate limiting untuk route ni, supaya kalau v3 tiba-tiba spike kami ada pelindung? Letakkan rate limit 5000 RPS per API key, applicable pada production environment.
Baik Encik, saya akan attach rate limit policy pada route tersebut.

messages.name: attach_gateway_policy
messages.content: {"policy_id": "pol-rl-tonton-rec-prod-001", "policy_type": "rate_limit", "target": {"target_type": "route", "route_id": "route-rec-prod-001"}, "environment": "prod", "status": "active", "effective_from": "2026-05-21T14:36:30+08:00"}

Rate limit policy `pol-rl-tonton-rec-prod-001` telah aktif, Encik — 5000 RPS per API key, reject HTTP 429 jika melebihi.

**Ringkasan sesi:**
1. Version baru `pv-tonton-rec-001-v3rc1` (v3.0.0-rc1) dicipta
2. Staging deployment `dep-stg-tonton-rec-v3rc1-001` ready
3. Prod canary `dep-prod-tonton-rec-v3rc1-001` in progress (10% -> +10% setiap 15 min)
4. Webhook `evtsub-tonton-rec-001` aktif untuk notifikasi rollout
5. Rate limit policy 5kRPS per API key dilindungi
6. 84 invocation timeout v2 dikenal pasti untuk retry kemudian

Adakah ada apa-apa lagi sebelum kita tutup sesi, Encik?

Last one — boleh suspend route untuk pipeline `pipe-tonton-search-002` di prod buat sementara? Search team minta deactivate untuk maintenance dalam 30 minit. Reason 'planned-maintenance-search-2026-05-21', fallback static_response 503.
Baik Encik, saya akan suspend route prod untuk Search Ranker dengan drain connections selama 60 saat dan fallback 503.

Please retry in 30 minutes."}}}

Route Search Ranker (`route-search-prod-001`) telah disuspend, Encik. Drain dalam progress sehingga 14:38:30, fallback 503 telah aktif. Search team boleh teruskan maintenance mereka sekarang.
Sempurna. Tak ada dah, terima kasih banyak-banyak. I'll watch the canary.

Sama-sama, Encik Lim. Terima kasih atas kesabaran. Webhook akan hantar setiap status_changed event ke endpoint Tonton. Sekiranya canary perlu di-rollback, gunakan `apply_emergency_rollback` atau hubungi semula kami. Selamat menjalankan tugas, Encik.
